reason: E1 shows that HCP-element concentration changes lattice distortion, dislocation core structure, and slip behavior in BCC RHEAs, supporting the mechanism that V addition could alter these features. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides direct evidence that V addition reduces dislocation barriers, enhances ductility, or preserves high-temperature and irradiation properties in NbMoTaW; these specific outcomes are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Adding V to NbMoTaW alters local lattice distortions and dislocation core structures
Altered dislocation core structures reduce barriers for dislocation nucleation and motion at room temperature
Reduced dislocation barriers enhance room-temperature ductility
High configurational entropy and retained BCC structure preserve high-temperature strength
Retained BCC structure and defect dynamics preserve irradiation resistance
